references.text: David seeks refuge in God's presence at a holy place, which mirrors Jesus' action of withdrawing to pray alone.
Jesus withdraws to pray in Gethsemane, reflecting his earlier practice of praying alone.
Jesus instructs on the importance of praying in secret, a practice he himself demonstrates in this event.
Luke highlights Jesus' habit of withdrawing to pray, which is consistent with the account in Matthew.
Jesus spends the night in prayer before choosing his disciples, showing the importance he places on solitary prayer.
